text:
Ava: Heads-up — ran into an accounting oddball in staging. Customer replayed a streaming session that contained a toolcall. The client got a truncation mid-stream, retried with the resume token, and billing shows BOTH a streaming-prefix charge and a toolcall charge for the same logical operation.

Ravi: Do you have the raw router logs? curious if the router treated the retry as a new path or a handoff.

Ava: Attached minimal logs below (sanitized):
```
[router] recv req session=svc-123 seq=42 route=canary-eu resume_token=tok-A
[sidecar] emit toolcall id=tool-77 session=svc-123 stage=invoked charge=toolcall
[router] conn drop EOF seq=42
[client] retry resume_token=tok-A
[router] recv req session=svc-123 seq=43 route=fallback-eu resume_token=tok-A
[sidecar] resume prefix captured len=1024 charge=stream_prefix
```
Looks like the resume landed on a different route (canary -> fallback) and both sides recorded charge events.

Marta: hmm — two likely culprits: (1) route-switch caused both shards to think they owned the toolcall prefix; (2) idempotency key wasn't surfaced to the resume path so toolcall dedupe didn't fire.

Theo: Agree with Marta. Also check the KV-cache prefix ownership code: we currently credit stream_prefix on first prefix snapshot even if a toolcall already recorded a token usage for the same session. If a resume lands on a different shard, the new shard has no visibility into previous toolcall billing.

Ravi: Can we reproduce with a deterministic route failover locally? If so we can test two fixes: surface toolcall idempotency via resume header, or make the ledger accept "merge credits" when resume token indicates same logical op.

Ava: Repro steps I used (short):
1) start local router with canary+fallback shards
2) send streaming request that triggers a toolcall (include X-Session-ID)
3) kill canary after toolcall but before final EOF
4) client retries with Resume-Token header that points to same session
Expected: only toolcall charge OR streaming-prefix consolidated to toolcall. Actual: separate charges on both shards.

Marta: Console/telemetry ask: can we show a "provisional vs confirmed" column for per-session billing on the trace view? That would make it obvious when provisional credits exist from retries.

ops-bot: Metric recorded: event=resume_double_charge count=1 props={route_transition:true, toolcall_present:true}

Theo: Implementation tradeoffs: 
- Option A (fast): require router to forward original toolcall-id in resume header so downstream dedupe can run. Low infra changes but relies on clients/resume token plumbing.
- Option B (safer): reconciliation job that post-processes provisional credits and collapses duplicates when session+toolcall-id match across routes. More infra but doesn't change runtime path.

Ravi: Note we can't retroactively change ledger entries for invoices, so reconcile must create a compensating credit rather than mutate charged events. We should also add an alert for >1 provisional charge per session in the billing dashboard.

Ava: Proposal: do A for quick mitigation (router header + resume-idempotency) + B for long-term cleanup (reconciler + console flag). I'll draft a PR for router/header change and a spec for reconciler.

Marta: I can take the console mock for provisional/confirmed column — will add to the rollout UX doc.

Ravi: SGTM. Who wants to own the reconciler design?

Theo: I can draft the reconciler spec and list edge cases (partial toolcall, multi-toolcall streams, cross-region stalls).

Ava: Filing INF-8421 for the header change + INF-8422 for reconciler spec. I'll post links once created.

Ravi: thanks — agreed next steps. :thumbsup:

Marta: :+1:

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window for header change targeting canary on Thu 09:00 UTC.

Ava: I'll open the PR today and tag @Ravi for review.
